speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy with feeding difficulties and abdominal swelling; can you tell me if you are passing gas or having bowel movements, and if so, how often?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see; does he vomit, and if so, is it green or bile-stained? Also, have you noticed any "sausage-shaped" lump in his belly or failure to pass meconium as a newborn?

speaker: Patient
text: There has not been fever, vomiting, or diarrhea like a stomach infection. The baby was born at 39 weeks without birth complications.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_Ultrasound; DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung's disease
